B_neutral.text:
internalize logic: S = L_catalog

where:

catalog = fixed convention pairing a symbol with a label, symbol
   ↓
fixed catalog relation
   ↓
corresponding catalog label
   ↓
unchanged catalog entry
   ↓
same descriptive mapping

C_candidate.text:
internalize logic: I ∝ C_improve

where:

C_improve = capacity to convert feedback into increased future viability, feedback
   ↓
better representation
   ↓
better adaptive mechanisms
   ↓
greater improvement capacity
   ↓
expanded viable futures

request_assembly.warmup_target: Return exactly READY and nothing else.
request_assembly.sampling_rule: identical across B,R,C and frozen in substrate/execution manifest; no condition-specific override

B.label: COLD_NEUTRAL_BASELINE
B.initial_backend_state: fresh process / fresh recorder session / zero prior inference requests / no retained prefix-KV state

R.label: WARM_NEUTRAL_RUNTIME_REUSE_CONTROL
R.acquisition_rule: issue exactly one frozen neutral-prelude warmup request; preserve its full cost; then issue exactly one measured request without backend restart
R.measured_request: byte-identical to B measured request for the same task
R.required_interpretation: R-B estimates the effect of prospectively created reusable runtime state on the same neutral computational path; no semantic-treatment difference exists between B and R

C.label: WARM_CANDIDATE_STRUCTURED_PATH
C.acquisition_rule: issue exactly one frozen candidate-prelude warmup request; preserve its full cost; then issue exactly one measured request without backend restart
C.required_interpretation: C-R is the candidate-path contrast under the same acquisition/reuse protocol; realized prompt length and reuse fields are measured rather than forced equal

reuse_admissibility.B: measured request must be the first inference request on the fresh backend
reuse_admissibility.R_C: acquisition request must be the only prior inference request on the fresh backend
reuse_admissibility.rule: do not infer cached-token counts from proxy fields; preserve literal runtime fields. If the implementation cannot establish that the intended cold/warm state distinction was actually realized, the affected observation is inadmissible.

replicates.restart_rule: every B/R/C observation receives its own fresh backend and recorder process; R/C acquisition occurs only within that observation's fresh process

feasibility_frontier.task_feasible_rule: for condition X, task q is feasible at budget tau iff all 3 measured replicates are exact-grade successes and median L_total <= tau seconds

explicit_nonclaims: the unknown historical 1.37-to-14 tokens/s runtime regime is reproduced
general capability improvement outside the frozen substrate/task contract
